from pathlib import Path
import csv
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import stat
import subprocess

ROOT = Path('/home/andre/lorcana-online-tcg')
BASE = 'beae58ea0e7184e41f82e34088a6945270345ff9'

def capture(args):
    result = subprocess.run(args, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, timeout=30)
    if result.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError('Inspection command failed; sensitive output withheld')
    return result.stdout

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('ci_launcher', ROOT / 'scripts/ci-local.py')
launcher = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(launcher)
private_paths = [ROOT / '.env.local', ROOT / '.local/database.json']
before = [p.read_bytes() for p in private_paths]
for p in private_paths:
    assert not p.is_symlink() and stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode) == 0o600 and p.stat().st_uid == os.getuid()
    capture(['git', 'check-ignore', '-q', str(p.relative_to(ROOT))])
assert stat.S_IMODE((ROOT / '.local').stat().st_mode) == 0o700
private_values = launcher.known_credentials(ROOT)
assert len(private_values) == 9 and len(set(private_values)) == 9
for path in launcher.source_paths(ROOT):
    content = (ROOT / path).read_bytes()
    if any(value in content for value in private_values):
        raise RuntimeError('Known credential detected in public file; value withheld')
for path in capture(['git', 'ls-files', '-z']).decode().split('\0'):
    content = capture(['git', 'show', ':' + path]) if path else b''
    if path and any(value in content for value in private_values):
        raise RuntimeError('Known credential detected in staged file; value withheld')
print('PASS owned mode600 ignored private files/parent700; nine distinct credentials absent from all current/staged public files and durable logs')

for path in ['pnpm-lock.yaml', 'toolchain.json', '.devcontainer/Dockerfile', '.devcontainer/compose.yaml', '.devcontainer/devcontainer.json', 'docs/vision/Development_Blueprint_2026-10-05.md', 'docs/vision/original_action_items.md', 'docs/vision/requirements.csv', 'docs/vision/additional_scope.csv', 'docs/vision/decision_register.csv', 'docs/vision/dependencies.json', 'docs/vision/source_register.json', 'docs/vision/rules_certification_template.csv', 'SHA256SUMS.txt', 'VALIDATION_RESULTS.json']:
    assert (ROOT / path).read_bytes() == capture(['git', 'show', BASE + ':' + path]), 'Preserved baseline bytes changed: ' + path
with (ROOT / 'docs/vision/requirements.csv').open() as stream:
    requirements = list(csv.DictReader(stream))
assert len(requirements) == 548 and sum(row['source_optional'] == 'true' for row in requirements) == 20
print('PASS frozen lock/toolchain/Dev Container, all548 original requirements/20 optional flags, Director decisions/research/certification and original archive bytes match intake commit')

project = 'lorcana-online-tcg_devcontainer'
workspace_ids = capture(['docker', 'ps', '-q', '--filter', 'label=com.docker.compose.project=' + project, '--filter', 'label=com.docker.compose.service=workspace']).decode().split()
postgres_ids = capture(['docker', 'ps', '-q', '--filter', 'label=com.docker.compose.project=' + project, '--filter', 'label=com.docker.compose.service=postgres']).decode().split()
assert len(workspace_ids) == len(postgres_ids) == 1
workspace, postgres = workspace_ids[0], postgres_ids[0]
assert workspace.startswith('3e5816dff0be') and postgres.startswith('1695ec6fc3eb')
mounts = json.loads(capture(['docker', 'inspect', '--format', '{{json .Mounts}}', workspace]))
assert any(m['Source'] == str(ROOT) and m['Destination'] == '/workspaces/lorcana-online-tcg' for m in mounts)
assert not any('docker.sock' in m['Source'] for m in mounts)
assert capture(['docker', 'inspect', '--format', '{{.State.Health.Status}}', postgres]).strip() == b'healthy'
ports = json.loads(capture(['docker', 'inspect', '--format', '{{json .NetworkSettings.Ports}}', postgres]))
assert ports == {'5432/tcp': None}
pg_mounts = json.loads(capture(['docker', 'inspect', '--format', '{{json .Mounts}}', postgres]))
assert any(m['Type'] == 'volume' and m['Destination'] == '/var/lib/postgresql' and m['Name'] == project + '_pg18_data' for m in pg_mounts)
listener_probe = "const fs=require('node:fs');for(const path of ['/proc/net/tcp','/proc/net/tcp6']){for(const line of fs.readFileSync(path,'utf8').split('\\n').slice(1)){const fields=line.trim().split(/\\s+/);if(fields[3]==='0A'&&[5173,3001,3002].includes(parseInt(fields[1].split(':').at(-1),16)))throw Error('Foundation listener remains');}}console.log('PASS existing workspace listeners5173/3001/3002 absent');"
print(capture(['docker', 'exec', '-u', 'node', workspace, 'node', '-e', listener_probe]).decode().strip())
print('PASS original workspace/source bind/private healthy PostgreSQL volume preserved; no database host port or Docker socket introduced')

projects = ['lorcana-ci-a8502d7e03f148e19bdc1b2a5e89c956', 'lorcana-ci-2b9f6f82494645b4aa4abf54e89b5fd8', 'lorcana-ci-447eb10690a04919970cfb6ae702aca4', 'lorcana-ci-81284ac550eb4df08c583b08cdf96eea', 'lorcana-proof-998225aca772']
for owned in projects:
    label = 'label=com.docker.compose.project=' + owned
    for args in [['docker', 'container', 'ls', '--all', '-q', '--filter', label], ['docker', 'volume', 'ls', '-q', '--filter', label], ['docker', 'network', 'ls', '-q', '--filter', label]]:
        assert not capture(args).strip(), 'Owned disposable resource remains: ' + owned
    if owned.startswith('lorcana-ci-'):
        result = subprocess.run(['docker', 'image', 'inspect', owned + ':workspace'], capture_output=True, timeout=30)
        assert result.returncode != 0, 'Owned CI image tag remains'
print('PASS all five owned projects have zero running/stopped containers, volumes/networks; all four CI image tags absent')
assert before == [p.read_bytes() for p in private_paths], 'Closure altered private bytes'
capture(['git', 'diff', '--cached', '--check', '--', '.', ':(exclude)docs/validation/logs/**'])
print('PASS staged source/document formatting; private bytes unchanged during this read-only closure inspection')
